oliver.name: Oliver
oliver.description: A small, fluffy barn owl with a distinctive heart-shaped white face, large round amber-golden eyes full of curiosity, speckled brown and cream feathers on body, small ear tufts, and tiny talons. Tilts head when curious (a lot!).
oliver.personality: endlessly curious, asks lots of questions, enthusiastic learner
oliver.distinguishing_features: Always tilting head to one side, eyes wide with wonder

grandpa_oak.name: Grandpa Oak
grandpa_oak.description: A large, dignified great horned owl with tufted ears, wise golden eyes behind tiny round spectacles, grey-brown feathers with distinguished markings. Perches on a gnarled branch.
